title: Whole-face regression sheet for the face station
why: Every prior card graded only its own region in its own render path: pink eyes from a stale GLB, double brows, a detail_bands pass dropped by the station and an olive lip band each passed their own gate while the whole face regressed. This module re-renders the station's actual output for every case in case-inputs.json and compares it with the last accepted whole-face state.

modules.role: resolve each case's latest completed station run; GLB = stage-4 lid-conform output, albedo = stage-3 final, normal+roughness from the same run dir; re-hash every recorded input and refuse on mismatch; spawn skin-realism/runtime-portrait-capture.ts in variant mode with an explicit --glb; assert the tool's output glb.sha256 equals the record sha; record planted renders.
Landmark point type only. The index table, masks and colour math live solely in regions.py (single implementation); TypeScript never names landmark indices.

THE region implementation via mise exec: imports face_gate_v2.detect_median (median of 3) and face_gate.resolve_model_path against the pinned landmark-model.json; disjoint masks by precedence (eyes, brows, lips, nose win; cheeks, forehead, chin keep only unclaimed pixels); mean CIEDE2000 dE, SSIM on L*, mean landmark displacement in px (reported, not gated); --golden-landmarks/--current-landmarks skip detection with fixture landmarks; per-region dE heatmap PNGs (fixed scale stated in the JSON) + bboxes + precedence in the metrics JSON; --dump-regions prints the table.
RegionMetric record shape (+ bbox type) only, so the pure decision and the sheet writer type their inputs. Measured solely by regions.py; no table, no masks, no colour math here.

pure evaluateFaceRegression decision (undeclared region beyond threshold = failure) plus exported summarizeCheckResults (absent cases listed, never failing; present case with missing golden still fails) plus the `check` and `--promote` CLI; default store /Volumes/files/openclinxr-assets/store/face-regression (brief path, no /src); writes runs/<card>/check.json and per case/view sheets from the regions.py heatmaps.

per case/view sheet: one row per region, cells golden crop | current crop | regions.py per-pixel CIEDE2000 heatmap crop, native pixels, no resampling. Composes the heatmap PNGs + bboxes from the metrics JSON; derives no anatomy, does no colour math.
immutable golden promotion: writes a NEW version dir, never opens an existing one for write, refuses planted renders.
threshold model threshold = max(noise, floor); no typed numbers.

thresholds.model: per region and metric, threshold = max(noise, floor)
thresholds.noise: max delta between two from-scratch renders of identical inputs (a re-render must not be called a regression)
thresholds.floor: metric between the golden and the golden with a +-1 8-bit code value perturbation, per channel, per pixel, clipped to 0..255
thresholds.state: uncalibrated: phase 2 (STEP 5/6) records the noise and floor measurement for each region and metric; the report cites that measurement for every threshold.
